note: Hybrid WebGPU C2C worker reference setup: original-XYZ tree rebuilding versus importing a validated exact f64 tree snapshot, with identical verification worker count and GPU/query/summary controls. CPU workers are prewarmed (time recorded separately). Every pair reloads identical reference bytes under a fresh identity; the main GPU tree/device is warmed by an excluded serial run, while both worker reference caches are empty. Five preparation warm-up pairs precede alternating timed pairs. Cold times include snapshot export, copies/transfers, worker import or tree construction, query snapshots, GPU readbacks, exact verification, joining and summaries. File loading and the main GPU reference construction are excluded. Each pair also records warm runs reusing both worker caches, in reverse order. Every cold and warm pair must match displayed f32 distance bits, exact reported f64 statistics and certificate counts; cold output also matches serial verification. Fallback is rejected. Phase intervals overlap and must not be summed. CPU/GPU clocks, power and other applications are uncontrolled; no cross-machine speed guarantee. Input hashes and optional provenance are recorded for supplied files.
